name: MSG_SWITCH_ON
meaning: mode 4; drive +400 when the sender is a RollingCarpet or SensibleButton

name: MSG_SWITCH_OFF
meaning: mode 4; drive -400 when the sender is a RollingCarpet or SensibleButton

name: MSG_CARPET_DRIVE
meaning: arg = s32* signed speed (u/s) from RollingCarpet states 4/5; returns 1 while not at a trajectory end

name: MSG_CARPET_SET_MODE
meaning: arg = RollingCarpet MOVING property (1/2/4), from RollingCarpet_Init
